description: Source code for Gemini (Veo) video generation API integration within the litellm project. Contains classes and functions to handle request transformation, response parsing, environment validation, and error handling for Gemini video services.

classes.name: GeminiVideoConfig
classes.description: Configuration and API handler class for Gemini (Veo) video generation, managing request/response transformations, environment validation, and error handling for Veo video operations.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _convert_image_to_gemini_format(image_file)
methods.description: Converts an image file object into Gemini's expected base64 encoded dictionary with MIME type.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported for Veo video generation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_openai_params( self, video_create_optional_params: VideoCreateOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to Gemini-specific video generation parameters, including conversions for size and duration.

methods.name: Optional[str] _convert_size_to_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Converts size specification like '1280x720' into Veo aspect ratio format such as '16:9'.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets up required environment variables and headers for Gemini API, including API key handling.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Veo video generation, based on model name and base URL.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,RequestFiles,str] transform_video_create_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, api_base: str, video_create_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Generates the API request payload for Gemini video creation, applying necessary transformations.

methods.name: VideoObject transform_video_create_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, request_data: Optional[Dict] = None, )
methods.description: Parses the Gemini API long-running operation response to extract operation name and create a VideoObject.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_video_status_retrieve_request( self, video_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the URL and parameters for polling the status of a video operation.

methods.name: VideoObject transform_video_status_retrieve_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Interprets the polling response to determine if the operation is complete, and constructs a VideoObject accordingly.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_video_content_request( self, video_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Fetches the completed video file URL by checking operation status and extracting the generated video URI.

methods.name: bytes transform_video_content_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Returns the raw video bytes content from the API response.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_video_remix_request( self, video_id: str, prompt: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, extra_body: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError as remix is unsupported by Veo API.

methods.name: VideoObject transform_video_remix_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError as remix is unsupported by Veo API.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_video_list_request( self, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, after: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, order: Optional[str] = None, extra_query: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError; listing videos is unsupported.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] transform_video_list_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError; listing videos is unsupported.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_video_delete_request( self, video_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError; delete operation is unsupported.

methods.name: VideoObject transform_video_delete_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError; delete operation is unsupported.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates a GeminiError exception class instance for API error reporting.
